credits.title: The Education of Jane Cumming
credits.overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

credits.overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. credits.title: Acts of Kindness
credits.overview: A student and her tutor sit in an office, navigating the end of their illicit affair. As they circle their wounds, reality fractures. A new world and characters are revealed, where transgressive power dynamics supersede connection.

credits.title: September Says
credits.overview: Sisters September and July share an intense bond, speaking in a secret language and keeping the outside world at a distance. After September is suspended from school, their mother brings them to a remote house on the Irish coast—where July begins to resist her sister’s increasingly sadistic control.

credits.title: CUR:FEW
credits.overview: Struggling to connect with his grieving 12-year-old daughter, a father released from prison on an electronic tag fights against time to fulfil her desire to perform in a school play.
